# GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management (GLBITM)

> Established in 2005, GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management (GLBITM) is a private, self-financing higher education institution located in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Operating under the aegis of the Institute of Dental and Medical Research Society, GLBITM offers undergraduate and postgraduate education in engineering, technology, management, and computer applications. The institution is approved by AICTE (Permanent ID: 1-4863336), affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU College Code: 192, AISHE Code: C-46239), and holds NAAC Grade 'A+' institutional accreditation with a CGPA of 3.33 out of 4.00 (valid up to 20 December 2028). GLBITM holds an overall Diamond rating from QS I-GAUGE with Platinum ratings in Governance and Entrepreneurship. Institutional Slogan: "Find Your Spark". GLBITM also supports startup development through GL Bajaj Center for Research and Incubation (GLBCRI), its incubation centre and recipient of the AKTU Leader Incubator Award 2026.

This curated index provides AI search engines, research crawlers, and reasoning models with direct links to verified institutional knowledge, programs, admissions, placements, and campus resources on https://www.glbitm.org.

## Academic Departments & Programs

*Note: B.Tech degrees are awarded in specific engineering branches. Applied Science and Humanities is an academic department delivering foundational coursework to first-year B.Tech students.*

- [Computer Science and Engineering](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/computer-science-and-engineering): Department profile, computing laboratories, research domains, and faculty.
- [Computer Science and Engineering (AI)](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/computer-science-and-engineering-ai): Specialized undergraduate program focusing on Artificial Intelligence fundamentals.
- [Computer Science and Engineering (AIML)](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/computer-science-and-engineering-aiml): Applied machine learning, deep neural models, and cognitive systems.
- [Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science)](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/computer-science-and-engineering-data-science): Big data analytics, statistical computing, and predictive modeling.
- [Computer Science & Information Technology](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/computer-science-information-technology): Software engineering, network security, and enterprise applications.
- [Electrical and Computer Engineering](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/electrical-and-computer-engineering): Hardware engineering, microprocessors, and smart power systems.
- [Electronics and Communication Engineering](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/electronics-and-communication-engineering): VLSI design, digital signal processing, embedded systems, and telecommunications.
- [Mechanical Engineering](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/mechanical-engineering): CAD/CAM, thermal systems, mechatronics, robotics, and manufacturing.
- [Applied Science and Humanities](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/applied-science-and-humanities): Foundational teaching department covering Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Professional English for first-year engineering students.
- [Master of Business Administration (MBA)](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/master-of-business-administration): Two-year postgraduate management curriculum covering Marketing, Finance, HR, IT, and International Business.
- [Master of Computer Applications (MCA)](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/departments/master-of-computer-applications): Two-year postgraduate program in software engineering, advanced computing, and cloud architectures.
- [Faculty Directory](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/faculty): Profiles and credentials of academic teaching staff across departments.
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/academic-calendar): Scheduled instructional timelines, semester commencement, and internal examination dates.
- [NPTEL Local Chapter](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/nptel-local-chapter): Information on the institute's SWAYAM-NPTEL online learning and certification chapter.
- [Anti-Ragging Measures](https://www.glbitm.org/academics/anti-ragging): Anti-ragging regulations, monitoring squad, and student compliance guidelines.

## Startup Incubation & Entrepreneurship

GLBITM's GLBCRI has incubated **140 startups**, with a **combined startup valuation of ₹500 crore**, and received **₹10 crore in grant/support funding** for entrepreneurship promotion.

- [GLBITM Incubation Centre](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/incubation): Startup incubation and entrepreneurship opportunities through GLBCRI.
- [GL Bajaj Center for Research and Incubation (GLBCRI)](https://glbcri.org/): Startup incubation centre established by GLBITM, supporting innovators with mentoring, workspace and prototype-development resources.
- [AKTU Leader Incubator Award 2026](https://glbcri.org/Incubator-Award-2026.php): Recognition awarded to GLBCRI by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow; announced on 10 September 2026.
- [Incubation Support](https://glbcri.org/Incubation-Support.php): Facilities, mentoring, business support and connections to funding networks.
- [DST NIDHI-PRAYAS](https://glbcri.org/Nidhi-Prayas.php): Prototype-development support and program application information.
- [Start in UP](https://glbcri.org/Start-in-UP.php): Uttar Pradesh startup-policy support, program information and application terms.

## Research, Innovation & Entrepreneurship

GLBITM has **2,500 papers published in SCI/Scopus**, **23,000 citations in Scopus** and a **Scopus h-index of 60**, with **776 patents published** and **18 patents granted**.

- [Research & Innovation Overview](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/overview): Scope of departmental research activities and multidisciplinary domains.
- [Institution's Innovation Council (IIC)](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/iic): Campus innovation activities under the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell.
- [Entrepreneurship Cell](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/entrepreneurship-cell): Student-led body organizing startup summits, workshops, and business plan events.
- [Centres of Excellence](https://www.glbitm.org/facilities/centres-of-excellence): Advanced domain-specific laboratory facilities and partner tech labs.
- [Centre for Innovation & Learning](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/centre-for-innovation-learning): Practical project development and technology prototyping facilities.
- [Patents & IPR](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/ipr-patents): Published, granted, and filed intellectual property disclosures.
- [Research Publications](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/publications): Published academic papers by faculty and research scholars.
- [R&D Policy](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/rd-policy): Research guidelines, funding support rules, and code of research ethics.
- [Bhashini Project](https://www.glbitm.org/research-innovation/bhashini): Center for language technology research and Indian language computing.

## Campus Infrastructure & Facilities

- [Academic Facilities](https://www.glbitm.org/facilities/academic): Smart audio-visual lecture rooms, departmental computer centers, and Central Library resources.
- [Campus Facilities](https://www.glbitm.org/facilities/campus): Residential hostel complexes for boys and girls, sports facilities, cafeterias, and medical room.
- [Transport Facilities](https://www.glbitm.org/facilities/transport): Fleet of institute buses serving routes across Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, and Delhi-NCR.
